title: Fibonacci Series
statement: Given an integer n, return the first n numbers of the Fibonacci sequence.
think: What is the task asking? Generate the Fibonacci sequence up to n items.
What is the key operation? Each next value depends on the previous two.
What wording signals stand out? Fibonacci, series, sequence.
Which pattern fits? Linear iterative build.
What is the brute force idea? Recursively compute every value.
What is the better/optimal idea? Build iteratively and reuse the last two numbers.
What are the edge cases? n = 0, n = 1, n = 2.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(n) space for the returned list.
How would I explain it in an interview? I initialize the first two values and keep appending the sum of the previous two.
algorithm: While list count < n, append sum of last two values
interview: I would build the sequence iteratively. After initializing 0 and 1, each new value is the sum of the previous two.
ru: В этой задаче важно помнить правило: следующее число равно сумме двух предыдущих.

critical: Start the sequence with wrong base values
important: Use recursion without understanding the extra cost
nice: Do not explain the previous-two-values dependency clearly

gaps: Important: remember base cases n = 0 and n = 1
Nice to have: compare iterative and recursive approaches
constraints: Assume n is small enough for int sequence values.
whyThisPattern: This is an iterative sequence-building problem: each step depends on a constant amount of previous state.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Sliding Window, because there is no moving range over input.
Not HashSet, because uniqueness is irrelevant.
